location: Nowra, Shoalhaven / South Coast, NSW, Australia

main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu and Couch grass on coastal sandy loam base)
main_turf.stretch_length: 405 metres — distinct uphill rise to the finish post
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Archer Racecourse at Nowra is one of the largest and fairest country circuits in New South Wales — a sweeping 2,019-metre championship-sized oval (comparable in circumference to Royal Randwick) paired with a testing 405-metre uphill home straight (+1.5m rise). Wide sweeping bends and the long uphill run-in prevent cheap front-runner steals and reward sustained stalkers ('P') and strong-finishing swoopers ('S' and 'C').
main_turf.post_bias: VERY FAIR DRAW PROFILE: Dedicated chutes at 1100m, 1200m, and 1400m provide generous straight run-ups before sweeping bends, minimizing wide-barrier penalties. Over 1600m routes, barriers 1-6 save ground into the first turn.

handicapping_angles.championship_2019m_oval_and_405m_uphill_: Do NOT handicap Nowra like a tight bush bullring — its massive 2,019m circumference and 405m uphill home straight test genuine final-400m stamina. One-dimensional early speed ('E') folds late under pressure; upgrade strong L400m/L200m closers ('P' / 'S') (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.sydney_metro_and_kembla_grange_shippers: Located just south of Kembla Grange and 2 hours from Sydney, Nowra is a prime strike zone for Sydney metropolitan yards (Bjorn Baker, Waterhouse & Bott, Annabel Neasham & Rob Archibald, Matthew Smith, Ciaron Maher NSW) and Illawarra provincial stables (Robert & Luke Price, Kerry Parker, Joseph Ible, Theresa Bateup). Upgrade Metro/Provincial droppers (+3.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.nowra_showcase_cup_big_dance_qualifier: The Nowra Showcase Cup ($100k+, 1600m, December) is an official Big Dance Eligibility Qualifier attracting Saturday midweek/provincial class gallopers.
handicapping_angles.south_coast_heavy_rain_shift: Coastal East Coast Lows can turn Archer Racecourse Soft 7 to Heavy 10; on rain-affected cards, riders scout lanes 4-8 off the fence down the 405m straight in the second half of the program.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2.5 (NSW Premier South Coast Showcase HQ)
